humanFeedback.text: The silhouette looks great, but the material treatment looks dark with muddy shading compared to the somewhat stylized tuning elsewhere give me three options to choose from
humanFeedback.approvedScope: Current holm-oak silhouette only; not materials or whole scene

hypothesis: Directional pigment ramps and restrained texture contrast can retain the approved structure while replacing muddy multiplicative foliage shading.

candidates.name: A — Warm painterly olive
candidates.construction: Smooth warm three-pigment ramp, restrained leaf detail
candidates.review: Warmest and most balanced match to existing illustrated scenery; some highlights are quite pale.

candidates.name: B — Soft silver-sage
candidates.construction: Cooler palette, softer lifted shadow transition, least texture contrast
candidates.review: Soft silver/sage appearance and readable interiors; less warm and less dimensional.

candidates.name: C — Graphic golden-green
candidates.construction: Narrow transitions between strong shadow/body/highlight bands
candidates.review: Strongest saturation and graphic separation; greatest risk of neon highlights and visible clump segmentation.

reviewer: Primary Codex inspected actual A/B/C tree renders
status: Awaiting human material choice; no candidate automatically retained as default
scope: Only holm-oak material shader and bark parameters, no geometry/placement/lighting changes
